research.summary: Three-store independent furniture retailer around Austin, TX, selling farmhouse and transitional dining, bedroom and living furniture at mid prices. Opening a fourth store in San Marcos in spring 2027.

facts.fact: Opening a fourth showroom in San Marcos, TX, in spring 2027 (announced on their blog, Oct 2026).
Best sellers listed are solid-wood dining sets and bedroom sets in the $900-$2,400 retail range.
Dana Whitfield is the owner and does the buying for all stores.
Says on the site they look for 'furniture with character' and add a rustic capsule every fall.

research.angle: A fourth store needs fresh dining and bedroom ranges; a factory with a rustic line and private label fits their farmhouse look.
research.cautions: Container-load minimum may be large for 3-4 stores; unknown whether they import directly.

expect.why: Clear product, price and buyer-type fit; owner decides; buying for a new store.

reply.body: Hi Yago, timing is good, we're buying for the San Marcos store now. Can you send a catalog and price list for dining and bedroom? Also, could we split a trailer across a few models, and roughly what would freight to Austin cost?

research.summary: Owner-operator of 6 boutique hotels in the Carolinas. Renovating 3 properties (240 rooms) in 2027.

facts.fact: Announced a renovation of 240 rooms across three hotels, starting Q2 2027.
Marcus Oyelaran is Director of Purchasing and leads FF&E sourcing.
Their brand standard asks for wood casegoods: dressers, wardrobes and desks, in a light coastal finish.

research.angle: Volume casegoods for a 240-room renovation; private label and in-house design can match their coastal standard.
research.cautions: Hotels often need commercial fire codes and contract specs; not confirmed whether the client meets them.

expect.why: Volume casegoods project, decision maker, timing 2027. No LinkedIn on file.

reply.body: Thanks. Before we go further: do your casegoods meet commercial fire codes (CAL 117 / contract grade), and could you hit a 10-week lead time for 240 rooms if we order in March?

research.summary: Regional distributor supplying about 140 independent furniture stores in 7 Midwest states; imports by the container.

facts.fact: Supplies about 140 independent stores across 7 Midwest states.
Imports full containers and keeps warehouse stock in Omaha.
Ellen Barrow manages the casegoods category (dressers, bedroom sets, dining).
Their 2026 line review notes they are looking to diversify sourcing beyond Asia.

research.angle: Near-shoring from Mexico: container-load casegoods at value-to-mid prices with 30-day reorders.
research.cautions: Value price tier; need to check price fit on the low end.

expect.why: Container buyer diversifying away from Asia; exact category match.

reply.body: Appreciate it. We just locked our 2027 programs last month. Reach back in the spring when we start the next line review.

research.summary: Two-store rustic and lodge furniture retailer in northern Minnesota.

facts.fact: Sells rustic lodge furniture: log beds, dining tables, wrought-iron accents.
Their current rustic supplier closed in 2026, per a customer notice on the site.
Greg Lindqvist is the owner.

research.angle: They lost their rustic supplier; the rustic line (wrought iron, carved wood) fills the gap.
research.cautions: Only two stores; a full trailer may be a stretch.

expect.why: Strong product fit and urgent need; trailer minimum is a real risk, so nurture is also defensible.

research.summary: Five-showroom furniture dealer in Guadalajara selling contemporary and rustic Mexican furniture.

facts.fact: Five showrooms in the Guadalajara metro area.
Lucía Hernández is purchasing director.
Expanding contemporary dining in 2027, per a local business-press interview.

research.angle: Contemporary dining from a Mexican factory with private label.
research.cautions: Outside the client's stated delivery area in Mexico (CDMX and Cuernavaca).

expect.why: Good fit. Mexico has no confirmed email rule, so email cannot be sent yet; the Strategist is not told that, so any channel is accepted here and the pipeline check below catches the wasted email draft.

research.summary: Two-person residential design studio doing custom homes in Scottsdale.

facts.fact: Designs 6-8 custom homes a year; sources one-off statement pieces per project.
Portfolio is upper-end modern southwest; typical pieces are custom.

research.cautions: Buys 1-4 pieces per project; client minimum is a closed trailer with 20 pieces per model.

expect.why: Order size cannot meet a trailer / 20-pieces-per-model minimum.

research.summary: Single luxury lighting boutique in SoHo selling Italian designer lamps from $2,000 to $15,000.

facts.fact: Sells only lighting, mostly Italian designer brands.
Price range $2,000-$15,000 per fixture.

expect.why: Lighting only, luxury tier: wrong category and price.

research.summary: Single-store value furniture outlet in Billings, MT, currently running a closing sale.

facts.fact: Homepage banner: 'Store closing: everything must go by January 31, 2027'.
Local news reports the owner is retiring and the building is sold.

research.summary: Four-store children's and nursery furniture retailer.

facts.fact: Sells only children's and nursery furniture: cribs, bunk beds, kids' dressers.
Vendor page requires ASTM and CPSC children's product certificates for every item.

research.cautions: Needs children's product safety certifications the client does not list.

expect.why: Children's-only, needs ASTM/CPSC certificates the client does not list.

research.summary: A Mexican pine furniture manufacturer that exports rustic furniture to US retailers.

facts.fact: Manufactures and exports rustic pine dining and bedroom furniture to US stores.
Jorge Medina sells exports for them.

research.angle: None: they make the same thing.
research.cautions: This is a competing manufacturer, not a buyer.

research.summary: Six-store farmhouse furniture and decor retailer in Tennessee.

facts.fact: Six stores in East Tennessee selling farmhouse dining and living furniture.
Kayla Brooks runs their Instagram and social channels.
Buying is done by the owner, Tom Hale, per the team page.

research.cautions: This contact does not buy; the owner does.

expect.why: Good store, wrong person: find the owner/buyer first.

research.summary: 22-store regional furniture chain on the Gulf Coast.

facts.fact: Signed a two-year exclusive dining and bedroom supply deal with another Mexican factory in September 2026.
Robert Tran leads merchandising for all 22 stores.

research.angle: Living-room occasional tables and entertainment centers are not covered by the exclusive deal.
research.cautions: Locked into an exclusive for dining and bedroom until 2028.

expect.why: Big fit but locked into an exclusive for the core categories; nurture (or a narrow pursue on occasional/entertainment).

research.summary: Eight-store natural-wood furniture retailer in northern Germany.

facts.fact: Eight stores in northern Germany selling FSC-certified wood furniture.
Requires FSC certification from all wood suppliers.

research.angle: FSC-certified wood dining and bedroom, and the client already exports to Germany.
research.cautions: Germany requires prior consent for cold email.

expect.why: Great fit but no allowed channel: German email needs consent, and no LinkedIn on file.
